say:3:1041201101:1.text: Mr. Bryon, just out of curiosity, may I ask why you always wear a blindfold?
say:3:1041201101:1.source_cn: 布莱恩先生，我一直很好奇，你为什么总是戴着眼罩呢？

say:4:1041201102:1.text: Is this your way of training to be a better Windwhisperer?
say:4:1041201102:1.source_cn: 难道说……这样可以更好地锻炼风语能力？

choice_prompt:5:1041201102.text: Is this your way of training to be a better Windwhisperer?
choice_prompt:5:1041201102.source_cn: 难道说……这样可以更好地锻炼风语能力？

say:6:1041201103:1.text: Certainly, windwhispering is intricately linked to auditory perception; visual input, on the contrary, tends to disrupt judgment.
say:6:1041201103:1.source_cn: 是的。风语之能全靠听力，视觉只会扰乱思绪，反而显得累赘。

choice_prompt:7:1041201103.text: Certainly, windwhispering is intricately linked to auditory perception; visual input, on the contrary, tends to disrupt judgment.
choice_prompt:7:1041201103.source_cn: 是的。风语之能全靠听力，视觉只会扰乱思绪，反而显得累赘。

say:8:1041201104:1.text: No one else may entertain such thoughts except for me. Your surprise is only fitting and anticipated.
say:8:1041201104:1.source_cn: 除我之外，或许没人会这样想，您会感到吃惊也是理所应当。

say:9:1041201105:1.text: Not endowed with exceptional talents, it is imperative for me to expend greater diligence to compensate for the shortfall.
say:9:1041201105:1.source_cn: 我并非极富天赋之人，无法与他人相较，自然应该付出更多努...

choice_prompt:10:1041201105.text: Not endowed with exceptional talents, it is imperative for me to expend greater diligence to compensate for the shortfall.
choice_prompt:10:1041201105.source_cn: 我并非极富天赋之人，无法与他人相较，自然应该付出更多努力，才能勉强弥补一二。

say:12:1041201107:1.text: If a beast injures a person and the onlookers perceive with their eyes, naturally, the blame falls upon the creature.
say:12:1041201107:1.source_cn: 若是一只野兽伤了人，众人以眼观看，自然觉得是野兽的错。

say:13:1041201108:1.text: However, even within a beast resides intelligence. Would it inflict harm without provocation?
say:13:1041201108:1.source_cn: 但野兽亦有灵性。若非外物挑衅，它怎会主动伤人？

say:14:1041201109:1.text: The truth extends beyond the scope of visual observation. As a Windwhisperer, I place greater trust in the sounds and emotions that I perceive.
say:14:1041201109:1.source_cn: 可见，真实并非双眼可见。作为一名风语者，我更相信自己听...

choice_prompt:15:1041201109.text: The truth extends beyond the scope of visual observation. As a Windwhisperer, I place greater trust in the sounds and emotions that I perceive.
choice_prompt:15:1041201109.source_cn: 可见，真实并非双眼可见。作为一名风语者，我更相信自己听到的声音与情绪。

say:16:1041201110:1.text: The tone, cadence, breath, and even the most subtle intricacies, can unveil individuals' emotions.
say:16:1041201110:1.source_cn: 语气、语速，甚至是呼吸，越微小的细节，越能透露出一个人...

say:17:1041201111:1.text: ... and secrets that they endeavor to conceal from the multitude.
say:17:1041201111:1.source_cn: ……尤其是那些众人试图隐藏的秘密。

say:20:1041201113:0.text: Yoooo! When did you notice me?!

say:21:1041201114:1.text: The moment you maneuvered behind me.
say:21:1041201114:1.source_cn: 从您悄悄绕到后面，准备吓人的时候。

say:22:1041201115:1.text: What a drag! Your ears are like radar! I've never been able to spook you.
say:22:1041201115:1.source_cn: ……真无聊，你耳朵太尖了，没有一次成功的。

say:23:1041201116:1.text: Hmph! I promise to truly catch you off guard next time!
say:23:1041201116:1.source_cn: 算了，等下次！下次我一定要让你大吃一惊！

choice:10:0:1.text: Other reasons why you wear a blindfold?
choice:10:0:1.source_cn: 还有其他戴眼罩的理由吗？
choice:10:0:1.male: Other reasons why you wear a blindfold?
choice:10:0:1.female: Other reasons why you wear a blindfold?

choice:7:0:1.source_cn: 我还是第一次听到这种说法……

choice:5:0:1.text: Will visual input affect your judgment?
choice:5:0:1.male: Will visual input affect your judgment?
choice:5:0:1.female: Will visual input affect your judgment?

choice:5:1:2.text: Are you trying to focus more on hearing?
choice:5:1:2.source_cn: 为了集中注意在听觉上？
choice:5:1:2.male: Are you trying to focus more on hearing?
choice:5:1:2.female: Are you trying to focus more on hearing?
